description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-09-08)

### ✨ New Features

* crossfade between songs for the Spotify TV app ([863dffd](https://github.com/ethan-manny/spotify-tv-crossfade/commit/863dffd6f8e584881ed0a7571358342f405ee8c0))

patches.name: Crossfade
patches.description: Crossfade between songs (0-12 s). Long-press Menu in the app to set the length.

patches.name: Debuggable build
patches.description: Marks the app debuggable: enables run-as access to app files and WebView remote inspection.

patches.name: Disable Amazon Appstore DRM
patches.description: Turns the Amazon Appstore (Kiwi) DRM lifecycle checks into no-ops so a re-signed APK runs.
